maximum_depth_rule: All 182 Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until KPI names, values, periods, units, Japanese and English source roles, and roadmap structure can be mapped through reviewed table-level evidence.
plan_boundary: The five registered official documents include the 2040 vision, the 2021-2030 basic plan, Japanese and English digests, and a manga document with no reviewed rows. Generic download titles, extraction artifacts, and multiple numeric tokens are retained without inferring structured actuals or targets.
non_goals: Do not infer annual actual or target fields from mixed raw statements.
Do not merge Japanese and English source rows as one KPI without review.
Do not correct PDF extraction artifacts or replace missing units by inference.
Do not convert prefectural or expert evaluation into an independent achievement judgment.
Do not calculate causality or cross-prefecture ranking.
